summary.text: NKT designs, manufactures and installs high-, medium- and low-voltage power cables, cable accessories and related cable services. The company is investing heavily in expanding its Karlskrona high-voltage offshore cable factory and states commitments to net-zero emissions and running production sites on green electricity.
